source:
A massive storm has destroyed most of the city. Players choose how they want to live in the aftermath.

Roles
👮 Police
🚑 Paramedic
🔥 Firefighter
🛠️ Mechanic
🧑‍🌾 Farmer
🛒 Shop Owner
🏠 Builder
🦹 Criminal
👨‍👩‍👧 Civilian
Features
Build and decorate your own home.
Buy and customize vehicles.
Start businesses like cafés, gas stations, or clothing stores.
Dynamic weather (storms, floods, heatwaves).
Jobs with progression and pay.
Optional PvP zones, with safe RP areas for players who don't want combat.
Seasonal events and community missions.
What makes it different

Instead of just living a normal city life, everyone works together to rebuild the town after disasters. New events keep changing the world, giving players fresh roleplay opportunities.

It mixes the everyday roleplay of games like Brookhaven with survival and rebuilding mechanics to make the world feel more dynamic

answers.ask: Should the city read as mostly wrecked and being clawed back, or mostly rebuilt with damage as flavour?
answers.answer: The city should read as mostly wrecked and actively being clawed back after the storm, with clear damage, debris, and incomplete rebuilding throughout.

answers.ask: How much city - a few neighbourhoods, or a sprawl with farms and outskirts? This may need the larger region frame.
answers.answer: Use a few compact neighbourhoods with a small farm/outskirts area, keeping the first map focused on a playable rebuilding community rather than a large sprawl.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: Should the city read as mostly wrecked and being clawed back, or mostly rebuilt with damage as flavour? A: The city should read as mostly wrecked and actively being clawed back after the storm, with clear damage, debris, and incomplete rebuilding throughout.
- [author] scale — Q: How much city - a few neighbourhoods, or a sprawl with farms and outskirts? This may need the larger region frame. A: Use a few compact neighbourhoods with a small farm/outskirts area, keeping the first map focused on a playable rebuilding community rather than a large sprawl.

## Enriched image prompt
Build one focused post-storm town map containing a few compact neighborhoods and a small farm at the outskirts. The city is mostly wrecked and actively being reclaimed: damaged roads, debris, roof and facade damage, incomplete repairs, construction lots, and partially rebuilt structures appear throughout. Organize residential home-building plots, a business strip for cafés, a gas station, and clothing stores, plus role facilities for police, paramedics, firefighters, mechanics, farmers, builders, and civilians. Connect all districts with vehicle-width roads and pedestrian access. Include enterable homes, businesses, and service facilities, a shared community center, raised refuge areas for flood events, and clearly separated safe roleplay districts and optional PvP ground.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim, with Survival secondary because disaster hazards and rebuilding materially shape the map.

## Shape and preset
Use `settlement-buildable`, the Roleplay & Avatar Sim shape BuildZone (Personalized Plots), because players build and decorate their own homes inside the shared town. Match the Home Builder preset and extend it with storm-damage and disaster-survival features.

## Config requirements
Use `path-road-vehicle` for connected roads serving neighborhoods, businesses, emergency facilities, and farm outskirts. Use `building-interior` for homes, cafés, shops, the gas station, and role facilities players enter. Use `social-hub` for a shared rebuilding-community center. Use `district-zoned` to separate residential, business, civic-service, farm, safe-roleplay, and optional-PvP ground. From Survival, use `destructible-cluster` for damaged and incompletely rebuilt structures, `terrain-tiered` for raised flood refuges, and `hazard-kill` for low-lying storm, flood, and heatwave event areas.

## Layout requirements
Place free-text Plot volumes on the uniform residential home lots, one per buildable footprint, with driveways facing the road; the source gives no exact lot count. Place free-text BoundaryZones around safe roleplay districts and optional PvP districts so combat permissions follow visible district edges. No hostile spawner is implied.

## Layout components
The map contains compact residential neighborhoods, one business strip, a civic emergency-services cluster, a shared community hub, and a small farm/outskirts zone. Roads and sidewalks connect every district. Residential blocks mix buildable lots with storm damage; business and service buildings have linked interiors. Debris, broken facades, construction staging, and incomplete repairs show active recovery. Low streets support disaster events, while raised refuges remain reachable. Keep all regions on one continuous map and frame the damaged community and farm boundary together.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: district boundaries, road connectivity, plot access, safe/PvP separation, and flood refuges must be coherent before post-storm dressing.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use large scale, corresponding to District, because several neighborhoods, civic services, businesses, and farm outskirts must coexist. The theme is a mostly wrecked modern town under active communal reconstruction. Use `P3` for exterior-to-interior play and `tiered` for raised flood refuge ground without overhang; no separate-map modifier applies.

options.text: Connected vehicle-width roads (with pedestrian access) serving neighborhoods, businesses, emergency facilities, and the farm outskirts.
Enterable interiors for homes, cafés, shops (including clothing stores), the gas station, and role facilities (police, paramedics, firefighters, mechanics, farmers, builders, civilian facilities).
A shared rebuilding-community center as the town’s main gathering hub.
Clear district separation: residential, business strip, civic/service cluster, farm/outskirts, safe roleplay districts, and an optional PvP ground.
Damaged and incompletely rebuilt structures and storm-wrecked building clusters throughout the town.
Raised refuge areas / high-ground relief used as flood refuges, reachable from low streets.
Low-lying storm-disaster zones for flood and heatwave events affecting the lower streets/areas.

layout.composition: Frame the damaged community and the farm/outskirts boundary together on one continuous map.

zones.role: Buildable home lots mixed with storm damage and active recovery.

zones.role: Role facilities for police, paramedics, firefighters, mechanics, builders, farmers, and civilians (service/civic functions).

zones.role: Community center gathering area supporting rebuilding roleplay.

zones.name: Small farm / outskirts zone

zones.name: Raised refuge areas
zones.role: High-ground refuges for flood events; safe reachable raised areas.

zones.name: Safe roleplay districts
zones.role: Clearly separated safe roleplay areas aligned to visible district edges.

zones.name: Optional PvP ground
zones.role: A distinct district for optional PvP, separated from safe areas.

layout.terrain: Modern town ground with post-storm damage; low-lying streets that support flood/heatwave disaster events, plus raised refuge areas (tiered high ground) without overhang.
layout.boundary: Single continuous town map including the farm/outskirts boundary; district edges are clearly readable.
layout.theme: Mostly wrecked modern town under active communal reconstruction after a storm (debris, broken facades, incomplete repairs, construction staging).
